profile.headline: Advocating enhancement of lifestyle by solving real world problems
profile.summary:
I am a self-driven, highly-organized, and goal-oriented tenured software development engineer. I am extremely passionate and enthusiastic about solving real life problems leveraging my critical thinking abilities with pragmatic approach. I have rich experience of working on large scale distributed systems while collaborating in multidisciplinary teams where I have demonstrated my excellent grasping power and potential to be an effective team leader. 

I am a results-driven software engineer with a Master's degree in Computer Science from NC State University and a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology from the University of Mumbai. I am passionate about leveraging technology to drive innovation and deliver high-quality software solutions. I have excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in Agile and Scrum environments. I have demonstrated a proven track record of success in delivering complex projects, improving system performance, and enhancing user experience.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Bhau Institute of Innovation and College of Engineering, Pune started 'Ignited Innovators of India' to undertook projects for social improvements and innovation. 

We team of 4 decided to feed the stray dogs in the Mumbai and Thane suburbs taking into account how some people treat these stray dogs with utmost atrocity and leave them to starve. The motto of this project was to understand the problems of street dogs and spread awareness among people to be kind to animals. Through our project, we wanted to do our part by helping the needy and the most ignored stray dogs.

During the project, we surveyed places in Mumbai and Thane suburbs to know the adversities faced by stray dogs and their sub-standard living conditions. We fed them with edibles and milk. Along with that we also spread awareness among the audience with the help of pamphlets and visual aids.

Techfest Green Campus Challenge was organised by Techfest 2013, IIT Bombay, it was an initiative for greener campus. This challenge included teams from all colleges all over India. In this challenge we had to finish more than 100 tasks related to sustainability, water, energy, green, etc.

To actively contribute for this challenge, we formed a team of 4 planned to take up various tasks like:
•	Took interviews of different environmentalists to understand the ongoing environment issues
•	Arranged seminars in public and within campus by notable environmentalists on topics like waste management, composting, etc. 
•	Reached large population through social networking site and spreaded awareness.
https://www.facebook.com/KJSCE.TGCC.TheGreenMile?ref=hl

Also conducted green march which was a walk of awareness by more than 100 people in different parts of Mumbai city in India holding posters and chanting slogans creating awareness about energy saving, tree planting, water saving, etc. This march was covered by 2 Indian newspaper Hindustan times and Indian express.
https://www.facebook.com/KJSCE.TGCC.TheGreenMile/photos/a.399004256837708.90508.385403564864444/399004510171016/?type=3&theater

Finally, we finished the challenge at 21st position all over India and 1st in Mumbai.

projects.title: Peer to Peer Centralized Index Server System (Java)
projects.description:
Developed a client - server application using socket programming in Java to facilitate file downloads between peers. This project was aimed to build a centralized index server which can act as a master and has all the information about it's active peers and files that it contains. The central server can handle multiple clients at a time and provide all the necessary information that a client may need. A peer also acts as a server for another peer who wants to download a file from that server. Each server can get the IP and the port of another peer from which it wish to download file from central server. In addition, a client can send ADD, LOOKUP and LIST ALL request to central server. 

o	Developed a server using Java multi-threading concepts such that server can handle multiple client requests.
o	Implemented a peer to peer and peer to server communication protocol.
o	Handled erroneous scenarios such as peer going down without properly closing a connection, peer providing wrong host information etc.
o	Each client can also act as a server and handle multiple clients at a time for downloading a file.

projects.title: Wolfpool (HTMLS, CSS, JavaScript, NodeJS, MongoDB)
projects.description:
Wolfpool is a web application to facilitate people to share their cab rides with people who are travelling in similar route at same time. This is especially useful where very popular cab services like Uber and Lyft does not provide their cab pooling services like UberPool and LyftLine. The project was essentially developed by other team and I enhanced the project and added some key features that a user will want in such a cab sharing application.

Accomplishments:
o	Enhanced a web application by enabling users to update and delete their existing plans.
o	Implemented a feature to check trip fare estimates by integrating with Uber and Lyft REST APIs.
o	Integrated Splitwise website to into the website so that people can track their expenses.
o	Added PayPal integration so that people can settle their overdue amount on the website itself and it can be used as a complete solution.

volunteerExperience.description:
Bhau Institute of Innovation and College of Engineering, Pune started 'Ignited Innovators of India' to undertook projects for social improvements and innovation. 

We team of 4 decided to feed the stray dogs in the Mumbai and Thane suburbs taking into account how some people treat these stray dogs with utmost atrocity and leave them to starve. The motto of this project was to understand the problems of street dogs and spread awareness among people to be kind to animals. Through our project, we wanted to do our part by helping the needy and the most ignored stray dogs.

During the project, we surveyed places in Mumbai and Thane suburbs to know the adversities faced by stray dogs and their sub-standard living conditions. We fed them with edibles and milk. Along with that we also spread awareness among the audience with the help of pamphlets and visual aids.

Techfest Green Campus Challenge was organised by Techfest 2013, IIT Bombay, it was an initiative for greener campus. This challenge included teams from all colleges all over India. In this challenge we had to finish more than 100 tasks related to sustainability, water, energy, green, etc.

To actively contribute for this challenge, we formed a team of 4 planned to take up various tasks like:
•	Took interviews of different environmentalists to understand the ongoing environment issues
•	Arranged seminars in public and within campus by notable environmentalists on topics like waste management, composting, etc. 
•	Reached large population through social networking site and spreaded awareness.
https://www.facebook.com/KJSCE.TGCC.TheGreenMile?ref=hl

Also conducted green march which was a walk of awareness by more than 100 people in different parts of Mumbai city in India holding posters and chanting slogans creating awareness about energy saving, tree planting, water saving, etc. This march was covered by 2 Indian newspaper Hindustan times and Indian express.
https://www.facebook.com/KJSCE.TGCC.TheGreenMile/photos/a.399004256837708.90508.385403564864444/399004510171016/?type=3&theater

Finally, we finished the challenge at 21st position all over India and 1st in Mumbai.
